name: ListKnowledgeBases
description: List the Bedrock knowledge bases that this connector can see. Usually not needed, because QueryKnowledgeBases already has a default knowledge base.

name: QueryKnowledgeBases
description: Search the company knowledge base (RAG) with a natural language question and return the most relevant passages with their sources. Use it for questions about documents, FAQs and product information.

query.description: The question or search text in natural language.

number_of_results.description: How many passages to return. Default 10.

knowledge_base_id.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the default knowledge base.
